column2: Full system access. Can manage all operators, users, and system-wide settings.
Similar to Super Admin but cannot manage Super Admin accounts or access system settings.
Belongs to a specific ferry/shipping operator. Can only manage their own operator's data.
View and search list of shipping lines
Set line name and line code
Set contact details (website, email, contact number, address)
Set booking behavior (schedule days ahead, cutoff, payment & booking provider)
Set booking rules (require mobile, require address, auto-confirm)
Set origin and destination ports for a leg
Assign a vessel to the schedule
Set operating weekdays and departure times
Select accommodation tiers offered on the voyage
Select vehicle types accepted on the voyage
Set vehicle fare and free-pax allowance per type
Set passenger-type discount per fare category
Select add-ons offered on the voyage
View all bookings under a leg
Cancel a leg with reason (must not already be cancelled)
Re-schedule a leg (must not be in "Scheduled" status)
Assign a vessel to a leg (no confirmed bookings, must be scheduled)
Issue bulk refunds for a cancelled leg
Filter legs by schedule, departure date, origin, destination and status
Approve a booking (must be in "Under Review" status)
Issue tickets on approval (Tripket and operator ticket numbers)
Record an operator's booking reference (on approval)
Cancel a booking with reason (not while Under Review, refunded or expired)
Process a refund on a booking (must be in "For Refund" status)
Update passenger details on a booking
Update vehicle details on a booking
Cancel a passenger ticket with reason
Process a refund on a passenger ticket (must be in "For Refund" status)
Cancel a vehicle ticket with reason
Process a refund on a vehicle ticket (must be in "For Refund" status)
View activity logs for a specific booking
Filter activity logs by actor, action and date
Update line profile (display name, logo, contact details, address)
Update booking behavior (schedule days ahead, booking cutoff, payment & booking provider)
Update booking rules (require mobile, require address, auto-confirm)
Disable / enable this shipping line (Danger zone)
Update passenger type details (class, name, discount)
Update vehicle type details (class, name, capacity, free pax, fare)
Update accommodation details (name, capacity, base fare)
